name: White River (Bayfield County)
gaugeName: WHITE RIVER AT MASON DELTA ROAD NEAR MASON, WI
blurb: White River (Bayfield County) in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed.
